use_case_name: Publish Air and Surface Surveillance Tracks

claims.content: To report air and surface surveillance tracks in a timely manner and with sufficient accuracy to support operational needs.

goal.raw_text: To report air and surface surveillance tracks in a timely manner and with sufficient accuracy to support operational needs.

claims.content: The C2 JU has received surveillance track data from a sensor system (e.g., radar, sonar) or another C2 node.
The C2 JU has processed the raw sensor data to form a coherent track with a unique Track Number (TN).
The track data meets the minimum quality standards for reporting as defined in paragraph 4.4.3.7 (Track Quality).
The C2 JU has determined that the track is not a duplicate of an existing track within its own database or from other sources it manages.
The C2 JU has applied any necessary filters (e.g., geographic, product type) to determine if the track should be published to the intended recipient(s).
The communication link to the intended recipient(s) is available and operational.
The C2 JU receives surveillance track data (point, line, or area) for which it has reporting responsibility.

trigger.raw_text: The C2 JU receives surveillance track data (point, line, or area) for which it has reporting responsibility.

claims.content: The C2 JU determines that it has reporting responsibility for a track based on its assigned Area of Responsibility (AOR), sensor coverage, or other operational directives.
The C2 JU formats the track data into a J-series message (e.g., J3.5 for air tracks, J3.4 for surface tracks) according to the standards defined in this document.
The C2 JU populates the mandatory fields of the J-series message, including Track Number (TN), position, velocity, course, speed, platform type, and Track Quality (TQ).
If applicable, the C2 JU includes optional information such as Identification Friend or Foe (IFF/SIF) data, Electronic Warfare (EW) product information, or special interest indicators.
The C2 JU applies any relevant transmission filters to determine which recipients should receive the track data.
The C2 JU transmits the formatted J-series message containing the surveillance track to the designated recipient(s) via the appropriate communication link.
